papers.title: NutriVisRAG: Multimodal Exemplar Grounding for Nutrient Estimation with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Diet is a major determinant of health, yet accurate dietary assessment from free-living meal images remains challenging. Existing retrieval-based Vision-Language Model (VLM) approaches to nutrient estimation typically rely on textual food representations, while, to our knowledge, direct grounding on visually similar annotated meals has not been investigated. We present NutriVisRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework that uses a vision encoder to retrieve similar meals with known nutritional annotations and provide them as multimodal in-context exemplars for VLM nutrient estimation at inference time, without task-specific fine-tuning. We evaluate NutriVisRAG across four datasets, four VLMs, three retrieval encoders, and two prompting strategies, including free-living meals from adults with insulin-treated diabetes, where carbohydrate estimates are compared against two dietitians' annotations. Across all 96 configurations (4 datasets x 4 VLMs x 3 retrieval encoders x 2 prompting strategies), NutriVisRAG reduced the primary estimation error in 56, with improvements more frequent under whole-meal (35/48) than per-item prompting (21/48). Across the evaluated configurations, the lowest NutriVisRAG error was below the best Vanilla error in 13 of 16 VLM--dataset pairs. For GPT-5.4-mini, under whole-meal prompting, the best-performing retrieval encoder for each dataset reduced the primary error on all four datasets relative to Vanilla, with reductions of 1.7--35.7%. Overall, our results show that grounding in multimodal exemplars comprising images and respective annotations can improve nutrient estimation at inference time without task-specific fine-tuning, although the benefits remain configuration-dependent.

summary.takeaway: 提出 NutriVisRAG，利用视觉编码器检索视觉相似的已标注餐食作为多模态示例，在推理时增强 VLM 的营养估计，无需任务特定微调，在多数配置下降低估计误差。
summary.methods: 检索增强生成框架：视觉编码器检索相似餐食及其营养标注作为多模态上下文示例；在 4 个数据集、4 个 VLM、3 个检索编码器和 2 种提示策略共 96 种配置下评估，包括胰岛素治疗成人的自由生活餐食并与两位营养师标注比较。
summary.relevance: 直接对应检索增强与对齐、多模态学习及跨模态理解与生成主题，展示如何用多模态检索示例对齐 VLM 输出。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出收益依赖配置，仅在 56/96 配置中降低主要误差；整餐提示优于逐项提示，且未报告所有配置下的统计显著性。

papers.title: Concertina: Embodying Manipulation and Cognition in One Diffusion Vision-Language Model
papers.abstract: Most vision-language-action (VLA) policies decouple manipulation from cognition by bolting an external action mechanism onto a vision-language model (VLM)--either quantizing actions into discrete tokens whose errors bear no stable correspondence to physical displacements, or delegating continuous trajectory generation to a separate action expert whose gradients compete with or are blocked from updating the VLM backbone. We argue that manipulation and cognition should instead be embodied in the same model, shifting from a decoupled VLA to an Embodied Vision-Language Model (eVLM). We introduce Concertina, an eVLM that places continuous trajectory representation, blockwise generation, and physical-coordinate supervision directly on the computation and parameter path of a shared diffusion VLM backbone. Each control timestep is encoded as one continuous latent action token in the backbone hidden space, and the shared Transformer reconstructs temporally ordered action blocks via the same corrupt-and-reconstruct operator used for multimodal pretraining. Active action projections account for only 0.21% of parameters in the 4.46B model with zero separate action-generator layers, compared with 16.5%-35.1% dedicated action-expert capacity in representative continuous VLAs. Using our proposed Action Interface Audit, we confirm that cross-time trajectory coupling emerges in the middle and late layers of the shared backbone rather than at the action interfaces. On standard benchmarks, Concertina achieves 98.15% average success on regular LIBERO, 85.9% on the 10,030-task LIBERO-Plus benchmark, and 4.142 average completed chain length on CALVIN ABC-D. Code: https://github.com/lose4578/Concertina Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/collections/Traly/concertina

summary.takeaway: 提出 Concertina，将连续轨迹表示、分块生成和物理坐标监督直接放在共享扩散 VLM 主干的计算与参数路径上，实现操作与认知在同一模型中的具身化。
summary.methods: 每个控制时间步编码为连续潜在动作 token，共享 Transformer 用与多模态预训练相同的损坏-重建算子重建时间有序动作块；提出 Action Interface Audit 分析跨时间轨迹耦合；在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 CALVIN ABC-D 基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及预训练、多模态学习与跨模态理解与生成，强调共享扩散 VLM 主干的具身视觉-语言建模。
summary.caveat: 摘要未与所有现有 VLA 方法进行全面比较，且 Action Interface Audit 的通用性未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: ArtiVidRM: Verifiable Artifact-as-Rubric Reward Modeling for Explicit Quality Articulation in Video Generation
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become an effective approach for improving video generation, but its success depends heavily on reliable reward models. Existing methods either map videos directly to opaque scalar scores or generate free-form rationales that are not explicitly optimized as the basis of the final judgment. We propose ArtiVidRM, a verifiable, artifact-as-rubrics video reward model that follows an observe-then-score paradigm. It first identifies visible generation artifacts and organizes them into a structured artifact list, then uses these artifacts as explicit rubrics for quality assessment. This intermediate representation grounds each score in concrete video-level evidence, making the reward more interpretable and informative for optimization. We further introduce a multi-reward reinforcement learning strategy to jointly optimize artifact prediction and quality assessment. The reward decomposes into complementary objectives that evaluate artifact prediction quality, including semantic coverage and prediction efficiency, together with a pairwise preference objective that supervises quality ranking through score differences. By jointly optimizing the intermediate artifact representation and the downstream preference prediction, the model learns to produce informative artifact lists while improving the accuracy of video quality assessment. Experiments show that ArtiVidRM achieves state-of-the-art performance on video preference benchmarks, provides effective signals for video diffusion optimization, and enables artifact-guided refinement of closed-source video generators.

summary.takeaway: 提出 ArtiVidRM，一种基于可验证伪影清单的视频奖励模型，先识别可见生成伪影并组织为结构化清单，再以其为显式评分标准评估视频质量。
summary.methods: 采用观察-评分范式；引入多奖励强化学习策略联合优化伪影预测与质量评估，奖励分解为语义覆盖、预测效率及成对偏好目标；在视频偏好基准上实验并用于视频扩散优化和闭源生成器伪影引导细化。
summary.relevance: 对应强化学习与多智能体与奖励学习主题，展示可解释奖励建模在生成模型对齐中的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称达到最先进性能，未给出具体数值或与基线方法的详细比较，伪影清单的覆盖范围可能有限。

papers.title: InnerLogic-Surg: An Open Surgical Foundation Model via Continual Pretraining
papers.abstract: Vision foundation models are the backbone of modern surgical image analysis, yet most surgical systems still rely on encoders pretrained on natural images or on specialist models trained from scratch on comparatively small datasets. Pretraining encoders on large amounts of surgery-specific data has the potential to generally enhance the performance of surgical image analysis methods simply by providing stronger backbones. Here we present InnerLogic-Surg, an open family of surgical vision encoders (21M--300M parameters) obtained by continually pretraining a transformer-based image encoder on millions of surgical images curated from 11,965 internet-sourced surgical videos spanning ~2,900 hours and more than fifteen procedure types. Our training recipe inherits DINOv3's pretraining stage to preserve representation ability after surgical adaptation, and additionally applies a learned feature-upsampling module for high-resolution dense prediction at low token cost. Across a benchmark covering workflow, instrument and anatomy recognition, segmentation, detection, and monocular depth, under the same architecture, the largest InnerLogic-Surg model achieves the best linear-probe performance in all 20 surgical tasks. We demonstrate that surgical continual pretraining yields transferable representations that generalize across procedures, anatomical regions, and task types, showing our surgical image encoders as a promising and scalable alternative to the procedure-specific representation learning approaches that have traditionally dominated surgical computer vision.

summary.takeaway: 发布 InnerLogic-Surg，通过持续预训练在数百万手术图像上获得开放手术视觉编码器家族，提供可迁移的手术领域表示。
summary.methods: 在来自 11,965 个互联网手术视频（约 2,900 小时、15 种以上术式）的数百万图像上持续预训练 Transformer 图像编码器，继承 DINOv3 预训练阶段并加入学习特征上采样模块；在涵盖工作流、器械和解剖识别、分割、检测和单目深度的 20 项手术任务上线性探测评估。
summary.relevance: 直接对应持续适应与预训练、自监督与表示学习主题，展示手术领域持续预训练的价值。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告线性探测性能，未说明下游微调效果；数据源自互联网视频，可能存在域偏差。

papers.title: Multimodal Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Medical Vision-Language Modeling
papers.abstract: Medical 3D scans and reports are inherently hierarchical, with diagnostic cues concentrated in specific anatomical regions across multiple levels of organization. Yet, most medical vision-language models ignore this structure and fail to focus on clinically relevant anatomy. We introduce MedHiVE, which combines hierarchical vision-language Soft Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) with contrastive learning to jointly model fine-grained anatomy and global scan context. To our knowledge, MedHiVE is the first framework to route both vision and text tokens through a two-level SMoE hierarchy organized by anatomical scale, coupling this with report-derived anatomy-level contrastive alignment for 3D medical imaging. This replaces the direct region-text alignment of statically pooled features and vision-only hierarchical routing of prior work with dynamic, slot-based cross-modal information flow across anatomical scales. MedHiVE operates via a two-level, learnable token-routing mechanism, where local image and text features are first routed through a local SMoE and then fused by a global SMoE into unified multimodal representations. Contrastive learning aligns both anatomy-level and global vision-language representations in a unified space. Pre-trained on 25,000+ CT scans with anatomical supervision, MedHiVE consistently surpasses 11 state-of-the-art methods across 6 datasets on 3 tasks: segmentation, classification, and detection, demonstrating the importance of hierarchical modeling. The code for MedHiVE is at github.com/szczurek-lab/MedHiVE.

summary.takeaway: 提出 MedHiVE，首个按解剖尺度组织两级 Soft Mixture-of-Experts 并路由视觉和文本 token 的 3D 医学视觉-语言框架，联合建模细粒度解剖与全局扫描上下文。
summary.methods: 两级可学习 token 路由：局部图像和文本特征先经局部 SMoE，再由全局 SMoE 融合为统一多模态表示；结合报告衍生的解剖级对比对齐；在 25,000+ CT 扫描上预训练，于 6 个数据集 3 项任务上与 11 种最先进方法比较。
summary.relevance: 涉及自监督与表示学习、多模态学习及跨模态理解与生成，强调分层专家路由在医学 3D 视觉-语言建模中的作用。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体性能提升数值，且预训练依赖解剖监督，在其他模态或解剖区域的泛化性未说明。

papers.title: HMVPS-DRP: Hybrid multi-view representation learning and pathway-state-aware graph learning for interpretable cancer drug response prediction with multi-omics data.
papers.abstract: Cancer drug response prediction is an important task in precision oncology and can support personalized treatment and candidate anticancer drug screening. Although many deep learning methods have been developed, existing approaches still do not fully exploit complementary information from different molecular views of drugs. Meanwhile, multi-omics data are often processed by independent encoders or simple fusion strategies, which limits the characterization of cell line molecular states. In addition, jointly modeling pathway structural priors and cell-line-specific pathway activity remains challenging. To address these limitations, we propose HMVPS-DRP, an interpretable multi-omics framework that integrates hybrid multi-view representation learning with pathway-state-aware graph learning. HMVPS-DRP first jointly learns molecular graph topology, SMILES sequence semantics, and substructure information from ECFP fingerprints to obtain complementary and comprehensive drug representations. Meanwhile, pathway connections based on gene-set overlap and cell-line-specific pathway activity states are integrated into pathway-cell line heterogeneous graphs, allowing the model to combine pathway structural information with cell-line-specific functional states. We further design a condition aware aggregation module that uses multi-omics data to regulate pathway information propagation and attention based feature aggregation, thereby enhancing cell line representation learning. Comprehensive experiments on the GDSC and PRISM datasets demonstrate the predictive performance of HMVPS-DRP. On the primary GDSC dataset, HMVPS-DRP achieves an RMSE of 0.9410, a PCC of 0.9364, and an SCC of 0.9165. Pathway and gene attribution analyses provide molecular-level interpretations of model predictions, while a melanoma case study highlights the potential of HMVPS-DRP to predict drug responses and support candidate anticancer drug screening.

summary.takeaway: 提出 HMVPS-DRP，一种可解释多组学框架，融合混合多视图药物表示学习与通路状态感知图学习以预测癌症药物反应。
summary.methods: 联合学习分子图拓扑、SMILES 序列语义和 ECFP 指纹子结构信息；将基于基因集重叠的通路连接与细胞系特异性通路活性状态整合为通路-细胞系异质图；设计条件感知聚合模块用多组学数据调控通路信息传播和注意力聚合；在 GDSC 和 PRISM 数据集上实验，并进行通路和基因归因分析及黑色素瘤案例研究。
summary.relevance: 对应药物扰动机制与自监督/表示学习主题，展示多组学与图学习在药物反应预测中的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告 GDSC 数据集上的 RMSE、PCC 和 SCC，未说明在 PRISM 上的具体数值及与基线方法的统计比较；案例研究为单癌种，泛化性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen's kappa of 0.781 (range: 0.753-0.807) and Fleiss' kappa of 0.77. Results show that general-purpose models, particularly GPT-5.1 and Gemini 2.0 Pro, generally outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop and high-level reasoning tasks, although performance declines as query complexity increases. KG grounding reduces hallucination rates across all evaluated models. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, domain-specific models do not consistently outperform general-purpose models on specialized tasks without graph grounding. These findings highlight the value of combining broad language-model capabilities with structured domain knowledge. We provide practical guidance for selecting LLM-KG integration strategies based on task complexity and computational constraints, and discuss hybrid neurosymbolic architectures for personalized medicine, cognitive disorder diagnosis, and explainable AI.

summary.takeaway: 基准测试五个 LLM 在五个异构知识图谱上的多跳推理与事实准确性，发现知识图谱接地可降低所有评估模型的幻觉率，通用模型在多跳和高层推理上通常优于领域特定模型。
summary.methods: 在 DrugBank、NeuroSynth、Cognitive Atlas、Brain Map 和 GDPKG 五个知识图谱上，用多层级查询数据集评估 GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen 和 BioGPT 在知识图谱感知与无知识图谱条件下的推理深度和事实准确性；报告标注者间一致性 Cohen's kappa 0.781 和 Fleiss' kappa 0.77。
summary.relevance: 直接对应大语言模型与知识图谱主题，探讨知识图谱接地对多跳推理和幻觉缓解的作用。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供各模型在各知识图谱上的具体性能数值；查询数据集和知识图谱选择可能限制结论的普适性。

papers.title: Provable Zeroth-Order Safe Exploration for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
papers.abstract: Safe reinforcement learning from human feedback (Safe-RLHF) seeks to improve helpfulness while satisfying harmlessness constraints. Existing primal-dual approaches can converge to feasible policies but do not prevent constraint violations during training. We study a stronger requirement, safe exploration for RLHF, under which every policy executed during training, including auxiliary exploration policies, remains feasible. We propose Zeroth-Order Log-Barrier Policy Gradient (ZO-LBPG), a reward-model-free method that optimizes a log-barrier objective using zeroth-order estimates derived directly from human preferences. To ensure safety under noisy feedback, we combine conservative constraint margin estimates with coupled rollouts and an adaptive step size that prevents updates from crossing constraint boundaries. We prove that, with high probability, all iterates and exploration policies remain strictly feasible, and that ZO-LBPG globally converges to an approximately optimal constrained policy. We establish a sample complexity of $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(\varepsilon^{-6}+d^3\varepsilon^{-5})$ trajectories and $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(\varepsilon^{-8}+d^5\varepsilon^{-7})$ human queries. Experiments on a synthetic CMDP and a language-model alignment task corroborate the training-time safety guarantees.

summary.takeaway: 提出 ZO-LBPG，一种无奖励模型的零阶对数障碍策略梯度方法，在 Safe-RLHF 中实现训练期间所有策略（包括探索策略）始终保持可行，并证明全局收敛到近似最优约束策略。
summary.methods: 使用直接从人类偏好导出的零阶估计优化对数障碍目标；结合保守约束边际估计、耦合 rollout 和自适应步长防止更新越过约束边界；在合成 CMDP 和语言模型对齐任务上实验；给出样本复杂度界。
summary.relevance: 对应强化学习与多智能体及奖励学习主题，聚焦 Safe-RLHF 中的安全探索理论保证。
summary.caveat: 摘要中的安全保证依赖高概率陈述和特定假设；实验仅限合成 CMDP 和单一语言模型对齐任务，实际大规模 RLHF 场景的有效性未充分验证。

papers.title: RAPTORGraph: graph-based pathway modeling for causal discovery in single-cell perturbations
papers.abstract: Experiments involving the perturbation of individual cells are central to understanding cellular mechanisms and can accelerate drug discovery. Causal representation learning allows us to uncover the latent factors that regulate biological systems and predict the impact of novel perturbations. Unfortunately, existing methods fail to address intervention spillover in a closed-world setting where intervention targets are known a priori, such as in Perturb-seq experiments, due to their reliance on dense encoders. Furthermore, incorporating curated biological pathways into the model imposes a confirmatory bias, forcing it to explain the data through preexisting pathways and reducing the set of hypotheses the model can explore, while discarding novel signals that lie outside the annotated pathways. In this work, we introduce RAPTORGraph, a {beta}-variational autoencoder with a GraphPathway encoder that explicitly models complex gene-to-gene interactions within learned pathways. Moreover, our model's preconditioning isolates the influence of perturbed genes, yielding clean, single-node latent interventions required for identifiable causal discovery and eliminating spillover. Finally, we train the model on data preprocessed with optimal-transport alignment, which guarantees a well-defined mapping between control and perturbed samples and further stabilizes the learned latent representations. We demonstrate that RAPTORGraph improves state-of-the-art performance on downstream analyses of unseen perturbations, such as non-additive interactions, while performing competitively on objective metrics, such as mean squared error and maximum mean discrepancy. The source code is available at https://github.com/sXperfect/RAPTORGraph.

summary.takeaway: 提出RAPTORGraph，用图通路编码器显式建模基因间交互，并通过预处理隔离扰动基因的影响，从而在单细胞扰动数据上实现可识别的因果发现并消除干预溢出。
summary.methods: 采用β-变分自编码器，结合GraphPathway编码器建模学习到的通路内基因交互；以预条件隔离被扰动基因影响，得到单节点隐干预；使用最优传输对齐预处理的数据训练，并在未见扰动与非加性交互等下游分析上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接对应单细胞扰动与机制推理主题，其图结构通路建模与自监督表示学习相关，可用于从Perturb-seq类数据推断因果调控关系。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体数据集、效应量或统计显著性；仅在摘要所述指标上报告竞争性表现，未见对通路先验偏差的定量消融。

papers.title: PBPO: Prefix-Block Policy Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) commonly decode responses by proceeding autoregressively across blocks while iteratively denoising multiple tokens within each block. This structure makes block-level policy optimization a natural adaptation of autoregressive policy optimization. However, the exact likelihood of a completed block is intractable because it marginalizes over the intermediate states and reveal orders of the denoising process. To realize the block-level formulation, we construct a prefix-block state and use a single model evaluation to define a factorized one-step surrogate for the block likelihood. The resulting block surrogate ratio is a product of its token surrogate ratios, allowing variation at individual positions to propagate across the entire block before clipping. We therefore introduce Prefix-Block Policy Optimization (PBPO), which preserves block-level conditioning but applies surrogate importance weighting and clipping separately to each token. PBPO further diversifies repeated updates by resampling corrupted views of the prompt and revealed prefix, a design motivated by masked-dLLM pre-training. Under our analysis assumptions, block-product weighting amplifies the variance of gradient contributions relative to token-local weighting. Across two LLaDA-family initializations, six benchmarks, and three generation lengths, PBPO achieves competitive performance against existing dLLM RL methods.

summary.takeaway: 针对扩散语言模型提出前缀块策略优化PBPO，在块级条件下对每个token分别做代理重要性加权与裁剪，以规避块级精确似然不可解的问题。
summary.methods: 构造前缀块状态，用单次模型评估定义块似然的可分解一步代理，块代理比率为各token代理比之积；对每个token分别加权和裁剪，并通过重采样提示与已揭示前缀的损坏视图增加更新多样性；在LLaDA系列初始化和六个基准、三种生成长度上评测。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习和大语言模型主题相关，涉及扩散LLM的训练目标与策略优化，可归入预训练/后训练方法讨论。
summary.caveat: 摘要分析表明块乘积加权相对token局部加权会放大梯度方差；实验仅覆盖LLaDA系列初始化与所测基准，摘要未报告具体增益数值。

papers.title: Describe Your Facial Expressions by Linking Image Encoders and Large Language Models
papers.abstract: This paper presents a novel task of describing human facial expressions of a facial image in natural language, which captures the nuances of facial actions and emotional states beyond traditional emotion categories or facial action units (AUs). To achieve the facial expression captioning model, we propose a three-stage training framework that trains a vision-to-language model using synthesized image-text pairs and the BLIP-2 pre-training techniques. To overcome the challenge of missing training image-text pairs for facial expression captioning, we propose a strategy that involves synthesizing and combining captions using GPT-3.5 and existing annotations on either emotion categories or AUs. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in generating captions that describe details of facial actions and emotions, as well as the inferential relationship between them, even when those emotions are not present in the training data. It is also demonstrated that the vision-to-language task enhances the performance of the intermediate visual features on both AU detection and emotion classification tasks.

summary.takeaway: 提出用自然语言描述人脸表情的新任务，并构建三阶段视觉到语言训练框架，可生成包含面部动作、情绪及二者推断关系的描述。
summary.methods: 利用GPT-3.5结合已有情绪类别或AU标注合成图文对，采用BLIP-2预训练技术分三阶段训练视觉到语言模型；在表情描述、AU检测和情绪分类任务上评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型、跨模态理解与生成以及预训练，展示LLM辅助数据合成与视觉语言模型在细粒度面部行为理解中的应用。
summary.caveat: 训练依赖合成标题，可能引入标注噪声；摘要未给出量化指标，也未说明合成数据与真实标注的分布差异影响。

papers.title: InfMasking: A Unified Variational Framework for Synergistic Multimodal Learning
papers.abstract: Multimodal models are expected to exploit synergistic information, that is, information available only when multiple modalities are observed together. In practice, however, a fusion module can fit the training objective by relying on a dominant modality or on information that modalities share, and the synergy between modalities is often left unused. We propose InfMasking, a unified multimodal learning framework based on Infinite Masking. Before fusion, InfMasking randomly masks the features of each modality; each sampled mask produces a different partial combination of cross-modal evidence and a fused representation of the corresponding modality interactions. All masked fused representations are required to remain consistent with a reference target: the unmasked fused view when training is unsupervised, and the class proxy of the task label when labels are available. Maintaining this consistency across diverse partial combinations discourages reliance on a dominant modality or on shared information alone, and drives the fusion module to learn cross-modal interaction patterns that remain meaningful under partial observations. Since the objective is an expectation over infinitely many masks, we model the masked fused representations as Gaussian and optimize closed-form variational bounds, whose population-moment gaps are controlled by the masking-induced covariance under this model. On the evaluated benchmarks, InfMasking improves predictive performance and yields higher mean PID estimates of task-label synergy in learned modality-specific representations, alongside higher InterSHAP interaction attribution in the trained predictors. Code is available at https://github.com/brightest66/InfMasking.

summary.takeaway: 提出InfMasking，在融合前对每个模态特征随机掩码，并要求所有掩码融合表示与参考目标一致，以促使模型利用跨模态协同信息而非主导模态或共享信息。
summary.methods: 基于Infinite Masking的统一多模态框架；无监督时参考目标为未掩码融合视图，有标签时为类代理；将掩码融合表示建模为高斯并优化闭式变分界；在多个基准上评估预测性能、PID协同估计和InterSHAP交互归因。
summary.relevance: 与多模态学习和跨模态理解相关，强调协同信息利用，也可与检索增强中的多模态对齐思路关联。
summary.caveat: 摘要未列出具体基准与提升幅度；理论部分依赖高斯建模假设，掩码诱导协方差对总体矩差距的控制为分析性结论。

papers.title: Multimodal Information Interactions Bottleneck for Multimodal Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract: Multimodal self-supervised learning is challenged by heterogeneity, unequal informativeness, and complex information interactions across multimodal data sources such as images, text, audio, and tabular data. While contrastive methods effectively align shared semantics, they typically rely on strong multi-view redundancy assumptions, overlooking modality-specific and synergistic information, thus leading to suboptimal representations. We propose the Multimodal Information Interactions Bottleneck (MIIB), a principled framework grounded in Partial Information Decomposition that explicitly encodes redundant, unique, and synergistic information within multimodal interactions. MIIB employs a dual-path model architecture for modality-specific encoding and multimodal fusion, optimized using surrogate tractable entropy-based objectives that enforce minimal sufficient representations without requiring explicit mutual information estimation. By leveraging variational bounds and score-based entropy estimation, MIIB efficiently captures complex cross-modal interactions while suppressing superfluous information. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art multimodal self-supervised methods. Code is available at https://github.com/wanglingzaishi/MIIB.

summary.takeaway: 提出基于部分信息分解的多模态信息交互瓶颈MIIB，显式编码冗余、独特与协同信息，避免仅依赖多视图冗余假设的对比学习局限。
summary.methods: 采用双路径架构分别进行模态特定编码与多模态融合；用可处理的熵代理目标优化最小充分表示，结合变分界与基于分数的熵估计，无需显式互信息估计；在多种多模态基准上评测。
summary.relevance: 对应自监督与表示学习及跨模态理解主题，为多模态对齐与融合提供信息论视角的表示学习框架。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体数据集与数值结果；熵估计与变分界带来的近似误差未在摘要中量化。

papers.title: RM-VLM: From Natural-Language Task Descriptions to Vision-Grounded Reward Machines
papers.abstract: Reward machines (RMs) have been proposed as a reward formulation in reinforcement learning (RL) to capture non-Markovian tasks where credit assignment depends on history. By representing reward functions as automata, RMs expose the task's temporal structure and allow such rewards to be handled within a Markovian framework. However, they assume a labelling function, a proposition-grounding oracle for observations, which must be manually engineered for each environment, limiting their wider applicability. In this work, we address this limitation by proposing RM-VLM, a novel approach in which a large language model (LLM) generates an RM from a natural-language task description, and a vision-language model (VLM) acts as the labelling function, grounding the RM's propositions over image-based observations during RM-guided policy learning. A VLM-based value function estimator is used to assess the agent's progress towards each RM transition and derive a dense reward signal. We evaluate RM-VLM on three domains covering non-Markovian grid-world navigation, robotic manipulation, and 3D object collection. Our experimental results show that RM-VLM consistently achieves higher task success rates than existing VLM-based reward methods across all tested domains.

summary.takeaway: 提出RM-VLM，用LLM从自然语言任务描述生成奖励机，用VLM作为标记函数在图像观测上接地命题，并用VLM价值函数估计进度以生成稠密奖励。
summary.methods: LLM生成奖励机；VLM将奖励机命题接地到图像观测；VLM价值函数估计器评估向各奖励机转移的进度并导出稠密奖励；在非马尔可夫网格导航、机器人操作和3D物体收集三个域上评估。
summary.relevance: 融合大语言模型、强化学习与多模态/跨模态理解，解决奖励机对手工标记函数的依赖，属于LLM引导任务结构化与视觉接地。
summary.caveat: 实验仅覆盖三个自建或选定域，摘要未给出成功率数值；VLM接地的可靠性及其失败模式未在摘要中讨论。

papers.title: Evaluating Language Model Features for Zero-Shot Time-Series Anomaly Detection Under Isolation Assumption
papers.abstract: Time-Series Anomaly Detection (TSAD) is a fundamentally challenging task: it is unsupervised, requires high local precision capabilities, and suffers from limited labelled data. Recent work has explored adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to time-series via cross-modal transfer. However, existing approaches are poorly suited to Multivariate TSAD (MTSAD), as tokenisation often obscures fine-grained temporal and variables structures, and most methods optimise auxiliary objectives such as forecasting or reconstruction. We posit that these surrogate objectives become unreliable as model capacity increases. Highly expressive models risk reconstructing or forecasting anomalies, undermining the foundations of both strategies. Instead, we propose to use LLMs purely as feature extractors and directly analyse their induced feature spaces. In this work, investigate the ability of LLMs to provide useful representations for MTSADs in a zero-shot setting through classification. To this end, we study the separability of the extracted features, under the assumption that anomalous features should be isolated from normal ones. We analyse their temporal and contextual discriminative ability using simple step-wise tokenisation schemes, with one time-step per token, which preserve fine-grained local information. Their usability for MTSAD is assessed using an unsupervised Isolation Forest, enabling a direct evaluation of the resulting representation quality. We further investigate whether the observed performance can be attributed to the language-related pre-training of the LLMs or arises independently of it. Our results provide empirical insight into the ability of LLMs to represent multivariate time-series for anomaly detection and highlight broader applications of cross-modal foundation models.

summary.takeaway: 研究将LLM纯作为特征提取器用于零样本多变量时间序列异常检测，在隔离假设下评估其诱导特征空间中异常与正常样本的可分性。
summary.methods: 采用每token一个时间步的简单分词以保留局部信息，用无监督Isolation Forest评估特征可分性；分析时间与上下文判别能力，并考察性能是否可归因于语言预训练。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型、预训练与跨模态迁移，探讨基础模型表示在时间序列异常检测中的可用性。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出随模型容量增加，预测或重建等代理目标可能不可靠；结论基于隔离假设与特定分词方案，摘要未给出具体检测指标或基准细节。

papers.title: Decoding Cell-type Specific Gene Regulation with CellReg3D by Integrating DNA Large Language Models and 3D Genome Structure
papers.abstract: Gene regulation is a core biological mechanism crucial for organismal growth and development. Recent advances in deep learning, coupled with increasing computational resources, have enabled large-scale modelling of gene regulatory processes. While numerous models have been proposed, effectively capturing long-range genomic interactions remains a central challenge. Here, we introduce CellReg3D, a multiscale and multi-modal deep learning framework designed to model cell-type-specific gene regulation by integrating local sequence patterns with long-range genomic interactions. Existing approaches often overlook the contribution of 3D genome architecture and face limitations in combining sequence-based features with chromatin interaction data. Specifically, CellReg3D overcomes these gaps by leveraging a DNA language model to encode sequence-level information and incorporating Hi-C-derived 3D chromatin interactions to capture chromatin spatial organization. We demonstrate that CellReg3D effectively learns epigenetic patterns and chromatin activity states, achieving state-of-the-art performance in predicting epigenetic marks and gene expression profiles across multiple cell types. Using interpretable methods, we illustrate how the model identifies cell-type-specific regulatory mechanisms and prioritizes functional non-coding variants. Furthermore, we apply CellReg3D to enhance the interpretation of expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) and uncover novel potential gene regulatory interactions. Overall, CellReg3D offers a integrative framework for decoding regulatory genomics, unifying sequence and 3D genome structure data to advance variant prioritization, disease mechanism discovery, and personalized functional genomics.

summary.takeaway: 提出CellReg3D，整合DNA语言模型编码的序列信息与Hi-C来源的3D染色质交互，以多尺度多模态方式建模细胞类型特异性基因调控。
summary.methods: 使用DNA语言模型编码序列级信息，结合Hi-C衍生的3D染色质交互捕捉空间组织；在多种细胞类型的表观遗传标记与基因表达预测上评估，并用可解释方法识别调控机制、优先排序非编码变异及辅助eQTL解读。
summary.relevance: 与DNA大语言模型及调控基因组学相关，涉及序列与3D基因组的多模态整合，也可服务于检索增强式的变异与调控解释。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体预测性能数值或对比基线细节；Hi-C数据的分辨率与细胞类型覆盖限制未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: La-JEPA: Compact Robot Policies with Latent World Modeling
papers.abstract: World-action models adapt pretrained video generators, and vision-language-action models build on pretrained vision-language backbones; both tie policy architecture and inference cost to large transformers designed for generation rather than control. It remains unclear how much these generation-oriented choices affect control. In this work, we introduce Latent Action JEPA (La-JEPA), a compact world-action model whose policy transformer is trained from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. Following Fast-WAM, La-JEPA learns to predict future features jointly with actions during training and generates only actions at inference. Among policies without embodied pretraining, La-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance in clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 scenes and on LIBERO-Plus with correct instructions, while using far fewer parameters than the strongest competing policies. It runs substantially faster than Fast-WAM at comparable performance and outperforms the closest JEPA-based methods, LeapBot-WA and JEPA-WAM, on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0 without their pretrained policy backbones. On four real-robot tasks, its average success is comparable to pi0.5 and above non-embodied-pretrained baselines. Through a design study of the choices behind La-JEPA, we show that JEPA features outperform video VAE latents, most clearly out of distribution, and that training-time future prediction choices significantly impact the policy even when future prediction is skipped at inference. We correct the LIBERO-Plus instructions, as the officially released evaluator corrupts them for most variants, and re-evaluate several strong open baselines. Without a generative pretrained policy backbone, La-JEPA is better and faster than far larger policies, suggesting that robot foundation models may benefit from architectures designed for control rather than inherited from generation.

summary.takeaway: 提出 La-JEPA：在预训练 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器的特征空间中，从头训练紧凑的策略 Transformer，从而在训练时联合预测未来特征与动作，推理时只输出动作。
summary.methods: 采用 Latent Action JEPA 架构，并遵循 Fast-WAM 的训练方式：在预训练 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器的特征空间中，从头训练一个紧凑的策略 Transformer；在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus 及四个真实机器人任务上进行评估；还做了设计研究，比较 JEPA 特征与视频 VAE latents，并分析训练时未来预测选择的影响。
summary.relevance: 与“预训练”主题直接相关：它探讨控制策略应当继承生成式大模型的架构，还是采用更适合控制、更紧凑的架构；同时也涉及“跨模态理解与生成”中特征表示的选择。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体参数量、推理时延和真实机器人任务成功率的数值；设计研究的结论限于摘要所述特征类型比较，未提供细粒度消融数据。

papers.title: Vision-language representations link food perception to subjective valuation
papers.abstract: Subjective values of foods guide dietary decisions. Yet, how the brain computes such values from visual input remains unclear. Here, we show that visual food valuation relies on higher-level conceptual representations captured by a multimodal vision-language deep neural network model. Using food images and human ratings (N = 194 and 200), we found that a vision-language model predicted subjective value more accurately than vision-only models. Representational analyses demonstrated that, compared with the vision-only model, the vision-language model preferentially encoded higher-level food attributes, including perceived healthiness, while encoding less image-level visual information. Multivariate analyses of fMRI data (N = 31) showed that embedding features from both models corresponded to activity patterns along the visual pathways. Critically, vision-language features showed greater correspondence than vision-only features in the fusiform gyrus, a downstream region of the ventral visual pathway. These findings suggest that higher-level conceptual representations link visual food processing to subjective valuation.

summary.takeaway: 视觉食物估值更依赖多模态视觉-语言模型所捕获的高层概念表征，而不仅依赖视觉模型提供的图像级信息。
summary.methods: 使用食物图像与人类主观价值评分（N=194 和 N=200），比较视觉-语言模型与纯视觉模型的预测能力；并进行表征相似性分析，以及对 fMRI 数据（N=31）进行多变量分析，考察嵌入特征与视觉通路活动模式的对应关系。
summary.relevance: 属于“多模态学习”与“跨模态理解与生成”：它表明视觉-语言表征与人类主观估值相关，为多模态表征的神经科学解释提供证据。
summary.caveat: 为相关性分析，不能确立因果；样本量有限，fMRI 仅 31 人，且结论依赖所选的模型与食物刺激范式。

papers.title: Egocentric Action Recognition with Objects and Vision-Language Affordances
papers.abstract: Action recognition, and more specifically egocentric action recognition, is a core task in computer vision, with applications such as monitoring the daily life activities of elderly people and task assistance. Recent methods rely on visual modalities such as RGB video or depth. However, in egocentric video, an action is largely defined by its objects, which these methods rarely model. We propose a method that combines a frozen SlowFast video expert with an attention-based object expert by late fusion. Each object is represented with its affordances, that is, what can be done with it, generated zero-shot by a vision-language model. Since datasets such as MECCANO annotate only the objects involved in each action, evaluating with these boxes tells the model which objects are active. We therefore train on annotated boxes and evaluate the method with detections from the official active-object detector, and with annotated boxes as an upper bound. Without affordances, our fusion reaches 68.4% Top-1 with annotated boxes but 49.0% with detections. About half of this drop comes from non-active detections. To remove them, the same vision-language model generates an interaction affordance that decides whether a hand is manipulating each detected object. On MECCANO, objects raise the Top-1 of the video expert from 44.9% to 49.0%, and the two affordances raise it to 49.9%, above SlowFast and object-aware RGB baselines. Code will be released upon acceptance.

summary.takeaway: 在以自我为中心的动作识别中，将冻结的 SlowFast 视频专家与基于对象的注意力专家进行后融合，并用视觉-语言模型零样本生成可供性，可提升识别性能。
summary.methods: 冻结 SlowFast 视频专家，并对对象专家采用基于注意力的后融合；每个对象用视觉-语言模型零样本生成可供性；在 MECCANO 上训练和评估，评估时分别使用官方主动对象检测器的检测结果和标注框（作为上界）。
summary.relevance: 与“多模态学习”和“跨模态理解与生成”相关：利用视觉-语言模型生成的可供性作为对象表征与交互判断，并融合视觉和语言知识。
summary.caveat: 使用检测框时性能明显低于使用标注框，50% 的下降来自非主动检测；方法在 MECCANO 上验证，跨数据集泛化未在摘要中说明；代码称录用后发布。

papers.title: ZeroRAG: Adaptive Semantic Peer Routing for Decentralized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a standard approach to enhance the reliability of large language model (LLM) outputs by retrieving documents relevant to a query and supplying them in the LLM prompt. Today's RAG systems collect, index, and serve these documents from centralized stores. In practice, however, documents are owned by organizations, devices, and individuals who cannot or will not surrender custody of them to a central party, e.g., because of privacy, copyright or regulatory compliance. Existing modern decentralized retrieval techniques either reintroduce a coordinating authority, or rely on a global data structure that requires continuous network-wide coordination (e.g., DHTs). We present ZeroRAG, a decentralized routing layer for document retrieval in RAG that performs semantic query routing across an overlay of peers with- out global data structures or centralized orchestration. Documents remain with the peers that own them, and each peer keeps only lightweight local state: a bounded set of neighbor advertisements and a cache of recently routed queries. Using these, ZeroRAG steers each query through a best-first walk that progressively rewires the overlay toward semantically relevant neighbors, so recall improves over time as the network self-organizes. We evaluate ZeroRAG using three real-world workloads and two decentralized baselines. We find that ZeroRAG outperforms baselines in terms of recall and required network messages, approaches the recall and LLM answer accuracy of a centralized document store, self-heals after catastrophic peer failures, and scales to 100 000 peers.

summary.takeaway: 提出 ZeroRAG：一种去中心化语义查询路由层，无需全局数据结构或中心化编排，即可在持有文档的 peers 叠加网络上进行 RAG 检索。
summary.methods: 每个 peer 只维护轻量本地状态（有界邻居广告和近期路由查询缓存），通过最佳优先游走逐步把叠加网络重连到语义相关的邻居；在三个真实工作负载和两个去中心化基线上评估，并测试大规模 peer 失效自愈和 10 万 peers 的扩展性。
summary.relevance: 对应“大语言模型”与“检索增强与对齐”：关注在隐私、版权或合规约束下，不集中保管文档时的 RAG 检索与路由。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体 recall、消息数或答案准确率的数值；对比对象为两个去中心化基线，与集中式存储的接近程度仅为定性描述。

papers.title: CacheGraft: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Latent-Space Document Enrichment
papers.abstract: Recent work in machine learning has demonstrated that transformer-based language model agents can communicate state not only through text, but also directly in latent space via key-value (KV) caches. In this paper, we argue that such cache-to-cache translation can provide utility beyond the original motivating application of real-time agent communication and can instead be utilized for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Building on the Cache-to-Cache (C2C) fusion framework, our proposed system CacheGraft encodes each corpus passage offline into a fused KV cache representation between a larger sharer model (4B parameters in our experiments) and a smaller receiver model (0.6B parameters) such that this cache can be injected into the receiver at query time with no need for the larger model. Across five QA benchmarks and two independent locally-run judges, CacheGraft improves answer quality over the text-only receiver baseline in 29 out of 30 comparisons, of which 17 of the 30 are statistically significant. Notably, these gains are zero-shot with respect to the fuser, which was never trained on retrieval data. These initial results suggest that latent-space document enrichment may be a promising avenue for enhancing the performance of RAG systems, particularly in compute-constrained settings where it is only feasible to deploy a small model at inference time.

summary.takeaway: 提出 CacheGraft：将语料段落离线编码为较大 sharer 模型与较小 receiver 模型之间的融合 KV cache 表征，查询时注入小模型，从而提升 RAG 答案质量。
summary.methods: 基于 Cache-to-Cache（C2C）融合框架，使用 4B 参数 sharer 与 0.6B 参数 receiver 在五个 QA 基准上评估，并由两个本地运行的独立评判器比较；fuser 未在检索数据上训练，属于零样本。
summary.relevance: 直接对应“检索增强与对齐”与“大语言模型”：探索以潜空间 KV cache 进行文档增强，而非拼接文本，尤其在推理端只能部署小模型的算力受限场景。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告 30 次比较中 29 次优于纯文本 receiver、其中 17 次统计显著，未给出绝对分数；结果依赖所选的 4B/0.6B 模型对与本地评判器，泛化性有限。

papers.title: Enhancing Repository-Level Code Completion with Reinforcement Learning in Real-World Scenarios
papers.abstract: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) for code, which closely aligns with the practical needs of real-world software development, has sparked growing attention in repository-level code completion. However, existing Code LLMs present challenges in focusing on suitable contexts from the repository and in deeply reasoning about cross-file dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework for repository-level code completion. To better understand both in-file and cross-file contexts, we employ identifier-driven intent recognition to capture completion intent, thereby improving the model's performance in real-world scenarios. To enhance cross-file reasoning, we propose a reward-driven completion learning to effectively reward in complex repository completion scenarios. To guide LLMs in completing code that aligns with intended functionality and repository context, we introduce a selective-exploration strategy that directs the model to focus on low-confidence, high-reward tokens, promoting the exploration of valuable, underexplored completion patterns. Experimental results show that our approach significantly improves the performance of Code LLMs. The code and the dataset are available at https://github.com/zhenlongDai/RepoCompletion.

summary.takeaway: 提出面向仓库级代码补全的强化学习框架，通过标识符驱动的意图识别、奖励驱动的补全学习和选择性探索策略，改善上下文聚焦与跨文件推理。
summary.methods: 采用强化学习框架；用标识符驱动意图识别捕获补全意图；用奖励驱动补全学习处理复杂仓库场景；用选择性探索策略引导模型关注低置信、高奖励 token；在仓库级代码补全任务上实验。
summary.relevance: 对应“大语言模型”与“强化学习”：将 RL 用于代码 LLM 的仓库级补全，涉及上下文选择与跨文件依赖推理。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体基准、指标数值或基线对比细节；所提各组件各自的贡献幅度未在摘要中量化。

papers.title: FedReason: Large Language Models as Weight-Space Meta-Aggregators for Heterogeneous Federated Learning
papers.abstract: Federated learning servers combine client models with a fixed aggregation rule, and each rule in common use is designed for one kind of heterogeneity. We study whether a large language model (LLM) that inspects the client models can choose the rule itself, without any training on the server. In FedReason, the LLM is called every ten rounds. It analyses the weights by running code in a restricted server-side sandbox, sees only the printed results, may score a few candidates on a 500-image proxy set, and submits a short Python aggregation program. The server applies the program until the next call and falls back to FedAvg whenever its output is invalid. Full weight tensors never leave the server. We evaluated FedReason with Claude Opus 5.5 on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with ResNet-18 under Dirichlet label skew, width-heterogeneous sub-models and Byzantine clients, in 168 runs against 14 baselines. Across 12 paired label-skew runs it beat FedAvg by 1.26 percentage points on average (10 wins), and a control that spends the same per-round proxy budget on choosing among standard rules by 1.08 points. It was the strongest server-side rule on CIFAR-100 but did not beat SCAFFOLD, which changes client training. With three of ten clients malicious, it excluded all sign-flipping clients from the first round and stayed about one point below FLTrust without training a root model. Without proxy feedback, accuracy fell from 73.8% to 38.8% in one seed. A 60-round run cost 0.79 USD in API fees on average.

summary.takeaway: 提出 FedReason：让 LLM 在服务器端检查客户端模型权重并自行选择或生成聚合规则，无需在服务器上训练；在部分异构场景中优于 FedAvg，但并非全面最优。
summary.methods: 每十轮调用一次 LLM：在受限服务器沙箱中运行代码分析权重，只查看打印结果，可在 500 张图像的代理集上给若干候选打分，并提交短 Python 聚合程序；无效输出回退到 FedAvg；使用 Claude Opus 5.5 在 CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100、ResNet-18、Dirichlet 标签偏斜、宽度异构子模型和 Byzantine 客户端下进行 168 次运行，对比 14 个基线。
summary.relevance: 涉及“大语言模型”与“检索增强与对齐”中的 LLM 作为元决策者/聚合器，以及联邦学习聚合规则选择。
summary.caveat: 未击败会改变客户端训练的 SCAFFOLD；Byzantine 场景下约低于 FLTrust 一个百分点；无代理反馈时某随机种子准确率从 73.8% 降至 38.8%；60 轮 API 费用平均 0.79 美元，结果依赖特定 LLM 与代理集。

papers.title: MCPHallu: Benchmarking Reasoning, Execution, and Memory Hallucinations in MCP Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), which allows them to discover and invoke tools across multiple servers at runtime. Existing MCP benchmarks primarily measure task completion; where they diagnose failures, they do so after execution rather than building specific reasoning, execution, and memory failure risks into task construction. We introduce MCPHallu, a benchmark for diagnosing hallucination-prone agent failures in MCP environments along three axes: reasoning, execution, and memory. MCPHallu contains 358 tasks across five capability domains and runs on 36 production MCP servers in isolated containers. Each task is designed with a structural trigger that makes one of four subtypes the dominant failure risk: Branch Collapse, Unreachable Goal, Tool Misuse, or Context Forgetting. This design enables subtype-level analysis rather than aggregate task success alone. We evaluate fourteen frontier LLM agents from eight vendors on 5{,}012 trajectories. Current MCP agents remain vulnerable to hallucination-inducing tool environments, achieving an average score of 0.642 on a $[0,1]$ scale (higher is better). Failures concentrate on Unreachable Goal tasks, where the average score drops to 0.458 and 23.2\% of runs pass, indicating that agents often continue issuing tool calls or claim successful completion rather than recognizing infeasible goals. Subtype rankings diverge sharply: a model's rank shifts by 6.9 of 13 positions on average across subtypes, and Branch Collapse is uncorrelated with Unreachable Goal across models ($r = -0.12$). MCPHallu is released at https://github.com/J1zz/mcp_hallu.

summary.takeaway: 提出 MCPHallu：沿推理、执行、记忆三个轴诊断 MCP 智能体幻觉倾向失败的基准，包含 358 个任务，覆盖五类能力域和四个失败子类型。
summary.methods: 在 36 个生产 MCP 服务器的隔离容器中运行；每个任务设计结构化触发，使 Branch Collapse、Unreachable Goal、Tool Misuse 或 Context Forgetting 之一成为主要失败风险；评估来自 8 家厂商的 14 个前沿 LLM 智能体，共 5,012 条轨迹。
summary.relevance: 对应“大语言模型”与“检索增强与对齐”：评估工具调用智能体的可靠性、幻觉与失败模式，属对齐与评测范畴。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告平均得分 0.642、Unreachable Goal 平均 0.458 且 23.2% 运行通过；基准限于 36 个 MCP 服务器和所选集任务，结论不一定覆盖所有 MCP 生态；子类型排名差异大，单一致分可能掩盖失败模式。

papers.title: Encoding and Propagation of Grammatical Number in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become an increasingly popular means of translating Large Language Model (LLM) hidden state vectors into a human-comprehensible list of features or symbols. As such, SAEs may provide insight into an LLM's knowledge representation and internal ``mental'' grammar - topics of pragmatic interest for mechanistic interpretation of AI behavior and of theoretical interest for the study of in silico representations of human language. Language models with fewer than 100M parameters, trained on small corpora, nonetheless exhibit strong grammatical competence and discourse coherence, despite producing content of limited reliability. We use SAEs that we trained on one such model (Pythia-70M) to conduct an in-depth examination of how a single grammatical phenomenon, number agreement, is represented and processed in an LLM. We demonstrate the mechanism and the methodology by which SAEs can be used to find and propagate ``plural noun'', ``plural matrix subject'', and ``generate a plural verb'' features which cause the LLM to produce plural verb forms such as ``are'', ``do'', or ``have'' instead of ``is'', ``does'', and ``has'' in response to prompts such as ``the men in the park''. We show that intervening to remove these features from the hidden states of plural subject noun tokens causes the model to produce singular verbs instead, and vice versa. We also show that corresponding ``singular noun'' and ``generate a singular verb'' features are not as effective for this task. This asymmetry suggests that Pythia-70m makes use of a privative representation of grammatical number in English. These findings replicated with larger LLMs Gemma-2-2b and Llama-3.1-8b yielded similar results. Our main contribution is a novel approach to the use of SAEs to understanding how LLMs encode human language that addresses a number of technical and methodological challenges.

summary.takeaway: 利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）在Pythia-70M中发现并干预语法数特征，表明模型可能采用否定式（privative）表示英语语法数。
summary.methods: 在Pythia-70M上训练SAE，定位“复数名词”“复数主语”“生成复数动词”等特征，并通过干预隐藏状态观察动词形式变化；在Gemma-2-2b和Llama-3.1-8b上复现。
summary.relevance: 该研究关注大语言模型的内部表示与机制可解释性，与“大语言模型”主题直接相关，并为理解模型对齐和知识表示提供方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告单一语法现象（数一致）在特定小模型上的机制及有限复现，未说明对其他语法现象或更大规模模型的普适性。

papers.title: Accelerating Safe Reinforcement Learning with Massive Parallelism
papers.abstract: We investigate the problem of scaling safe reinforcement learning (safe RL) to massively parallel training regimes, where a large number of environments are exe- cuted with short rollout horizons. Although this setting improves data throughput and wall-clock efficiency, it creates a mismatch with constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs), whose safety constraints are defined over full-episode cost returns. We address this mismatch by analyzing staggered environment resets as a phase-mixture distribution over short trajectory segments. This analysis charac- terizes the bias induced by phase coverage and motivates a phase-aggregated cost estimator that reconstructs episode-level cost estimates from short rollout batches. We further incorporate finite-sample uncertainty and distribution mismatch into a constraint-tightening framework, yielding a scalable Safe RL method compatible with on-policy optimization. Using an MJX-based implementation of Safety Gym, our experiments show that the proposed method achieves performance comparable to non-massively parallel implementations while substantially reducing wall-clock training time.

summary.takeaway: 针对大规模并行安全强化学习中短轨迹与CMDP全回合约束不匹配的问题，提出相位聚合成本估计与约束收紧框架。
summary.methods: 将交错环境重置分析为短轨迹段的相位混合分布，构建相位聚合成本估计器，并纳入有限样本不确定性和分布不匹配进行约束收紧；基于MJX实现Safety Gym进行实验。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于安全强化学习与大规模并行训练，与“强化学习”主题直接相关，也涉及训练效率与对齐安全约束。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体任务数量或统计显著性细节，仅称性能与非大规模并行实现相当且减少墙钟时间；约束收紧的保守性可能影响样本效率。

papers.title: FewStepRL: Fine-tuning Few-step Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard post-training method for diffusion models, but most RL objectives roll out the current policy at every iteration, and with a many-step sampler these rollouts typically dominate the cost of training. Few-step models cut this cost, yet they model an average velocity over an interval, whereas existing RL objectives are built for an instantaneous velocity with a many-step sampler. We adapt RL objectives to few-step models systematically in three phases, namely a transformation, a decomposition and an adaptation. The transformation to $x$-space expresses each objective we consider through a common policy prediction, at the clean end by default and at an explicitly marked level for transition or flow-map objectives, so that objectives stated over densities, velocities or rewards become comparable. The decomposition writes the gradient of each of these objectives as the sum of a self-regression toward a reference and a reward augmentation, so that a method reduces, at the gradient level, to a choice of anchors and weights. The adaptation computes each anchor from a few-step model at the end of its transport or along its tangent, with the instantaneous velocity recovered from the network itself or from an auxiliary network. This yields few-step versions of FlowGRPO, AWM, DiffusionNFT, DiffusionOPSD and ReFL in one modular codebase. In our experiments, reward-gradient-based methods are the most effective when the reward is differentiable and its gradient is affordable; otherwise DiffusionNFT-style methods generally reach high rewards in relatively few iterations despite a sometimes higher per-iteration cost. Extra inference steps show no systematic aggregate benefit in our experiments, although selected outputs visibly improve with two to four times as many sampling steps as in training.

summary.takeaway: 系统地将强化学习目标适配到少步扩散模型，通过变换、分解与适配三阶段统一FlowGRPO、AWM、DiffusionNFT等方法。
summary.methods: 将目标变换到x空间统一表示，把梯度分解为自回归参考项与奖励增强项，并从少步模型或辅助网络恢复瞬时速度；在模块化代码库中实现五种少步RL方法进行实验。
summary.relevance: 该研究将强化学习后训练用于扩散模型，与“强化学习”主题直接相关，并涉及生成模型的对齐与微调。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出额外推理步数未带来系统性总体收益，仅部分输出在2–4倍采样步数下可见改善；不同方法的每迭代成本与奖励可达性存在权衡。

papers.title: Monotone Viability Learning for Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Offline safe reinforcement learning requires reliable long-horizon safety estimates from fixed data. Learning Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) viability in this setting calls for semantic preservation, convergence, and numerical stability. To address these challenges, we propose Monotone Viability Learning (MoViL), which learns viable sets from offline transitions through monotone finite-horizon set recursion. The recursion preserves finite-horizon safety semantics and converges to the infinite-horizon viability kernel. Binary supervision maintains a fixed target scale across horizons, avoiding discount-induced numerical attenuation. We further establish sufficient conditions for recovering behavior-supported viable subsets. The learned viability estimates are used to certify actions at deployment. Dubins car experiments validate the numerical accuracy of the learned viable sets. Evaluations on safe RL benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art reward-cost performance. MoViL satisfies the average cost constraint on every task and achieves the lowest average cost among the compared methods. These results highlight MoViL's potential to extend long-horizon HJ viability analysis to safety-critical systems where reliable dynamics models are unavailable and online exploration is unsafe.

summary.takeaway: 提出单调可行性学习（MoViL），从离线转移数据学习有限时域可行集递归并收敛到无限时域可行性核。
summary.methods: 采用单调有限时域集合递归与二元监督保持目标尺度，建立恢复行为支持可行子集的充分条件，并将学习到的可行性估计用于部署时动作认证；在Dubins car和安全RL基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 该工作面向离线安全强化学习与长期安全估计，与“强化学习”主题直接相关，涉及安全约束下的策略学习与认证。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明离线数据集覆盖不足时可行性核恢复的理论保证强度，也未报告计算复杂度；实验限于Dubins car和标准安全RL基准。

papers.title: IMUDINO: Self-distilled Foundation Model for Inertial Sensing
papers.abstract: We present IMUDINO, the first foundation model (FM) for inertial sensing to achieve competitive performance across diverse sensing tasks including human activity recognition (HAR), health, motion capture, and odometry. Prior inertial FMs often focus on one subfield of inertial sensing and sometimes underperform state-of-the-art supervised methods (e.g., in HAR), making their scope considerably narrower than FMs for vision and natural language. Moreover, they often require fixed input length and sampling rate, and generalize poorly to unseen sensor locations. To build a general-purpose foundation model for inertial sensing, we adapt the DINO self-supervised learning (SSL) paradigm to inertial data through a set of semantics-preserving motion transformations that simulate variations in motion pattern and sensor setup. For model architecture, we use a plain transformer encoder with frequency-aware positional encoding that natively supports varying input length and sampling rate. This simple setup proved remarkably effective for learning global and dense features generalizable across users, sensor setups, tasks, and, in the case of robot odometry, embodiments. We hope IMUDINO can serve as a backbone for inertial sensing and kickstart the development of general-purpose inertial FMs.

summary.takeaway: 提出IMUDINO，首个面向惯性传感的通用基础模型，在人类活动识别、健康、动作捕捉和里程计等多任务上取得有竞争力的表现。
summary.methods: 将DINO自监督学习范式适配到惯性数据，设计保持语义的运动变换模拟运动模式与传感器配置变化；采用带频率感知位置编码的普通Transformer编码器支持变长输入和采样率。
summary.relevance: 该研究属于预训练与自监督表示学习在惯性传感领域的应用，与“预训练”“自监督与表示学习”主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供各任务的具体性能数值或与监督基线比较的统计细节；结论主要基于摘要所述任务范围，跨领域泛化程度需进一步验证。

papers.title: A Generative Foundation Model for Multimodal Tokamak Tasks
papers.abstract: Tokamak experiments record diverse measurements, including waveforms, profiles, fields, and scalars, which are used to reconstruct the plasma, forecast its evolution, recover associated control signals, and estimate disruption risk. Most models are built separately for one task and a fixed set of inputs and outputs, and each relies on a prescribed subset of diagnostics rather than structuring the full multimodal observation set to extract global, cross-signal information about the discharge. These limitations motivate a reusable foundation model that adapts to each task's input-output schema and models heterogeneous target signals jointly, rather than retraining a separate model for every configuration. In this work, we extend the TokaMark benchmark with two groups of tasks for actuator action inversion and disruption prediction, yielding 20 MAST tasks in six groups with explicit schemas and evaluation protocols. Then, we introduce GenToka, a generative tokamak foundation model that jointly generates schema-selected targets through a shared conditional diffusion Transformer, with signal-specific codecs preserving native time series, profiles, fields, and scalars; foundation pretraining and task-specific adaptation transfer cross-signal structure across all six groups. Evaluation on MAST measurements shows that GenToka reduces macro-average normalized root mean squared error relative to TokaMind by 4.7% on Groups 1-4 and by 17.7% on Group 5, and improves macro-average window-level F1 on Group 6 by 8.4% at a common validation-selected threshold. GenToka provides a reusable, generative, and multimodal pathway for experimental tokamaks, linking plasma-state reconstruction, actuator inference, and disruption warning from shared measurements to support more integrated, data-driven fusion plasma prediction and control research.

summary.takeaway: 提出生成式托卡马克基础模型GenToka，通过共享条件扩散Transformer联合生成模式选择的多模态目标，并扩展TokaMark基准至20个MAST任务。
summary.methods: 使用信号特定编解码器保留时间序列、剖面、场和标量，进行基础预训练与任务特定适配；在MAST测量上评估执行器反演、破裂预测等六组任务。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于多模态基础模型与预训练在科学数据上的应用，与“预训练”主题相关，并涉及跨任务生成与对齐。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告了相对TokaMind的NRMSE和F1改进，但未说明不确定性估计或跨装置泛化能力；结论限于MAST实验数据。

papers.title: When, Where, How: Active In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) adapt to a new task only through the labeled rows in their context. However, labels are expensive to acquire in real-world scenarios due to the need for highly specific domain knowledge to ensure high-quality data. Active in-context learning transfers classical acquisition rules to this setting, in which the model that guides acquisition changes with every label added. We ask how the value of diversity, predictive uncertainty and target-aware information gain changes as a frozen TFM acquires more context. For that, we study Target-Aware Nearest Neighbor (TANN) acquisition and the Expected Predictive Information Gain in Context (EPIC) and evaluate them against classical rules. Our study across twenty benchmarks with two well-established TFMs and classical GBDTs highlights three findings: (i) When: diversity-based acquisition is best during the first acquisition iterations; (ii) Where: labeling pool rows that serve the target inputs via a simple target-aware nearest-neighbor rule matters substantially; (iii) How: EPIC yields the best models at the label budget, retains on average 80--87% of the chance-corrected full-data performance with only 5-10% of the pool labeled on the eight benchmarks with the largest pools, and selects labels that also improve the predictive performance of gradient-boosted decision trees.

summary.takeaway: 研究表格基础模型在主动上下文学习中的采集策略，发现多样性早期有效、目标感知近邻规则重要、EPIC在标签预算下表现最佳。
summary.methods: 在二十个基准上比较TANN、EPIC与经典采集规则，使用两种表格基础模型和经典GBDT，分析采集价值随冻结模型上下文增加的变化。
summary.relevance: 该工作涉及表格基础模型的上下文学习与主动学习，与“预训练”“检索增强与对齐”主题相关，关注数据高效适配。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明所有基准上EPIC均最优，仅称在最大池的八个基准上保留80–87%全数据性能；结论依赖所测试的TFM和GBDT设置。

papers.title: Few-shot regulatory sequence design with a genomic language model
papers.abstract: A central challenge in generative biology is translating knowledge learned from natural sequences and experiments into designs with desired functions. In-context learning (ICL) is an emergent capability of large language models that allows them to adapt to new tasks from a few examples without additional training, enabling these models to become general-purpose learners. Here, we show that the genome language model, Evo 2, exhibits generative ICL in biological sequence design. Prompting with just tens of examples conditions Evo 2 to generate novel and diverse regulatory DNA sequences without any additional training. Mechanistic analysis suggests that genomic ICL may originate from induction, similar to phenomena observed in natural language. Reinforcement learning leveraging sequence-to-function models as experiment-derived rewards further strengthens ICL. We first validate this approach by generating enhancers that drive cell-type-specific gene expression in three human cell lines. Extending this approach in vivo, enhancers designed using human regulatory element data selectively label layer 5 extratelencephalic neurons in the mouse cortex with high specificity and stronger activity than existing enhancers. Our study provides evidence of emergent properties in genomic sequence models and introduces a promising approach for improving functional conditioning in generative biology.

summary.takeaway: 展示基因组语言模型Evo 2在调控序列设计中具有生成式上下文学习能力，仅需数十个示例即可生成新颖多样的调控DNA序列。
summary.methods: 通过少样本提示Evo 2生成调控DNA，结合机制分析探讨归纳头式机制；利用序列到功能模型作为实验衍生奖励进行强化学习增强ICL；在三种人类细胞系和小鼠皮层体内验证增强子。
summary.relevance: 该研究将大语言模型的上下文学习和强化学习用于生成生物学序列设计，与“大语言模型”“检索增强与对齐”“强化学习”主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供ICL机制分析的定量证据或强化学习增强的消融细节；生成序列的功能验证限于特定细胞系和增强子类型，普适性需进一步检验。

papers.title: scPhyloGRN: gene regulatory network inference guided by lineage topology in single-cell developmental data.
papers.abstract: MOTIVATION: Gene regulatory network (GRN) inference from single-cell transcriptomes is complicated by expression patterns associated with both cell state and shared ancestry. Cellular phylogenies provide developmental context, but incorporating relationships among individual cells into gene-level regulatory inference remains challenging. RESULTS: We present scPhyloGRN, a supervised framework that integrates single-cell gene expression with cellular phylogeny to prioritize directed transcription factor (TF)-target candidates within the observed gene set. The framework maps cell ancestry to gene associations that guide graph construction, attention in a dual-stream encoder, and lineage-consistency regularization. We evaluated scPhyloGRN against ten methods across 17 dataset-reference settings spanning four mouse embryos and one Caenorhabditis elegans dataset. scPhyloGRN showed an overall advantage in regulatory edge prioritization, supported by additional evaluations using shared candidate spaces. Removing lineage information reduced AUPRC in the ablation analyses, while branch-level and regulator-level analyses showed improved ranking and recovery of reference-supported regulatory candidates. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Source code and analysis workflows are available at https://github.com/Maria0852/scPhyloGRN, with a versioned archive at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22793831.

summary.takeaway: 提出 scPhyloGRN，利用单细胞发育数据中的细胞谱系拓扑指导基因调控网络推断，在多个数据集上优先排序有向转录因子-靶标候选边方面整体优于十种方法。
summary.methods: 监督框架整合单细胞基因表达与细胞系统发育，将细胞祖先关系映射为基因关联，用于图构建、双流编码器中的注意力以及谱系一致性正则化；在四个小鼠胚胎和一个秀丽隐杆线虫数据集的17个数据集-参考设置中与十种方法比较。
summary.relevance: 直接针对 GRN/Regulon 推断主题，通过引入谱系拓扑信息改进从单细胞转录组推断基因调控网络。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体性能数值；评估主要基于候选边优先排序，未充分说明在全部基因集上推断完整网络的能力；消融显示去除谱系信息降低 AUPRC，但未量化其他潜在混杂因素。

papers.title: PSGAgent: Enhancing MLLMs' Dynamic Visual Perception for Panoptic Scene Graph Generation via Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract: Panoptic Scene Graph generation (PSG) requires holistic yet fine-grained reasoning over complex relations among objects. However, current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) applied to PSG suffer from a perception bottleneck: they function as static observers limited by fixed-resolution views. As a result, models often overlook critical relations involving small or peripheral objects and struggle to differentiate ambiguous predicates in complex scenes. To address these limitations, we propose PSGAgent, an agentic framework that enhances visual perception for PSG through a think-act-observe loop. PSGAgent allows MLLMs to dynamically refine their visual perception using two tools: a Region Zoom-In Tool for local exploration of small or boundary relations and a Visual Highlight Tool for relation-focused segmentation that filters out irrelevant contextual noise. To optimize decision-making, we construct a two-stage training pipeline. First, we create a high-quality, error-aware Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (M-CoT) dataset that provides robust supervision for cold-start learning. Then, we design a novel hierarchical reward mechanism integrated with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) to enable strategic and adaptive tool usage. Extensive experiments on the PSG benchmark show that PSGAgent achieves SOTA performance, demonstrating strong capability in both holistic and fine-grained scene understanding.

summary.takeaway: 提出 PSGAgent，通过思考-行动-观察循环和区域放大、视觉高亮工具增强多模态大模型的动态视觉感知，以提升全景场景图生成中关系与谓词的细粒度推理。
summary.methods: 基于多模态大语言模型的智能体框架，包含两个工具：区域放大工具用于局部探索小或边界关系，视觉高亮工具用于关系聚焦分割；构建错误感知的多模态思维链数据集进行冷启动，并设计分层奖励机制结合 Group Sequence Policy Optimization 进行训练。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型、强化学习和多模态学习，与检索增强与对齐及跨模态理解与生成相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在 PSG 基准上达到 SOTA，未给出具体指标或误差分析；方法依赖工具调用和训练数据，泛化到其他场景图数据集或开放场景的能力未说明。

papers.title: WAM-Sim0.1: World Anchored Memory Meets Online RL for Consistent and Realistic Driving Simulation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive driving world models systematically suffer from structural drift, identity drift, and quality decay over long rollout horizons due to transient conditioning signals that lack persistent state. We present WAM-Sim, a driving world model anchored by a persistent hierarchical memory and optimized via online flow-matching RL. WAM-Sim structures persistent context across three temporal and semantic scales: pose-aligned structural tokens encoding persistent road topology, read-only scene tokens supplying geolocated background appearance, and write-once instance tokens preserving individual traffic participant identities across occlusions and chunk boundaries. To restore visual sharpness and physical plausibility degraded by multi-scale conditioning, we introduce an online post-training framework that optimizes self-generated rollouts via flow-matching RL guided by hierarchy-aligned visual rewards and a vision-language model physical judge. The invariant memory empirically confines policy optimization within the anchored context, helping suppress semantic collapse and reward hacking, while online RL systematically enforces physical commonsense and fine-grained visual fidelity. On the nuScenes benchmark, WAM-Sim achieves a superior generation fidelity (FID=3.47, FVD=25.72) and strong downstream perception performance (24.16 mAP, 71.23 road mIoU). On minute-scale rollouts of self-collected data, WAM-Sim substantially mitigates structural and identity drift, preserving high scene similarity and subject identity coherence across extended horizons. Project page: https://fudan-generative-vision.github.io/WAM-Sim.

summary.takeaway: 提出 WAM-Sim，一种由持久分层记忆锚定并通过在线流匹配强化学习优化的驾驶世界模型，旨在缓解长时自回归生成中的结构漂移、身份漂移和质量衰减。
summary.methods: 分层持久记忆包括姿态对齐结构 token、只读场景 token 和一次写入实例 token；在线后训练框架利用流匹配强化学习优化自生成 rollout，奖励由层次对齐视觉奖励和视觉语言模型物理评判器引导；在 nuScenes 基准和自采集数据上进行分钟级 rollout 评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及强化学习、多模态学习和跨模态理解与生成，与驾驶世界模型和在线 RL 优化相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告了 FID、FVD、mAP、road mIoU 等指标，但未提供与所有基线方法的完整统计比较；在线 RL 和视觉语言模型评判器的计算成本及潜在偏差未讨论。

papers.title: AttnSR: Attention Step Reward for Long-Horizon Agentic RL
papers.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents make multi-step decisions, yet outcome-reward-only reinforcement learning provides little direct supervision for individual steps. We introduce AttnSR, a step-level reward augmentation method that derives reward allocations from policy attention extracted during training replay, without a separately trained reward model or additional rollouts. AttnSR traces backward through the policy model attention graph to estimate the relevance of earlier steps to the final response. The terminal step, measured relative to a running baseline, determines whether these rewards reinforce or penalize the selected steps. In a controlled Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct study, AttnSR consistently outperforms the PPO baseline across all evaluated checkpoints on ALFWorld, raising final held-out success from 91.2% to 97.1%. The ablation experiment shows that the benefit depends on how intermediate rewards are assigned, rather than simple accumulation of step rewards over time. AttnSR also improves ScienceWorld at every checkpoint while cutting environment interactions by 29.9%. These results support policy attention as a practical prior for step-level reward allocation in long-horizon agentic RL. Code is available at https://github.com/fairyshine/AttnSR .

summary.takeaway: 提出 AttnSR，一种从训练回放中提取策略注意力来分配步级奖励的增强方法，无需单独奖励模型或额外 rollout，在长时程智能体强化学习中提升最终成功率并减少环境交互。
summary.methods: 通过策略模型注意力图反向追踪估计早期步骤与最终响应的相关性，以终步相对运行基线的表现决定奖励是强化还是惩罚所选步骤；在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上于 ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 环境评估，并与 PPO 基线比较。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型、检索增强与对齐和强化学习，与长时程智能体步级奖励分配问题相关。
summary.caveat: 受控研究主要基于 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和两个环境，跨模型、跨任务的泛化性未验证；摘要未说明注意力作为奖励先验在何种条件下可能失效。

papers.title: What Gets Hacked in a Collaborative Reward for LLM Recommenders: The Part That Does Not Depend on the User
papers.abstract: Collaborative-filtering (CF) scores provide graded, personalized rewards for training large language model (LLM) recommenders through reinforcement learning. However, these rewards can cause exposure collapse: even though the CF model itself produces diverse top recommendations across users, an LLM optimized with its rewards concentrates on fewer items. We decompose each score into an item-mean component, the item's average CF score across user histories, and a residual component, the current user's score deviation from the average. Through controlled interventions, we identify the item-mean component as a contributor to exposure collapse. Accordingly, we propose two reward corrections: per-item centering removes each item's estimated mean score, while per-item standardization further rescales the residual using its estimated standard deviation. Experiments on two datasets with two identifier schemes show that both corrections substantially improve catalog coverage and exposure evenness. Compared with training on the uncorrected CF reward, our corrections increase the number of distinct items ranked first across users by up to $9.8\times$, while maintaining comparable ranking accuracy. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LLM4Rec-CF-Bias-27EF/.

summary.takeaway: 分析协同过滤奖励中与用户无关的项目均值分量会导致 LLM 推荐器曝光坍缩，并提出逐项中心化和逐项标准化两种奖励校正方法，在保持排序准确度相当的同时提升目录覆盖和曝光均匀性。
summary.methods: 将每个协同过滤分数分解为项目均值分量和用户残差分量；通过控制干预识别项目均值分量的影响；在两种数据集和两种标识符方案上比较未校正奖励与两种校正方法。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型、检索增强与对齐和强化学习，与基于协同过滤奖励的 LLM 推荐器训练相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告校正后最多将不同用户排名第一的不同项目数提高 9.8 倍，但未给出覆盖率和曝光均匀性的具体数值；实验限于两种数据集和两种标识符方案，实际部署中的长期影响未评估。

papers.title: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
papers.abstract: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion. However, autoregressive vision-language models generate these plans one coordinate token at a time, making richer predictions increasingly costly. We introduce VFlash, a method for fast, accurate visual planning through Flash Primitive Decoding. VFlash exploits the known structure of visual primitives to predict their coordinates jointly, using a lightweight drafter that generates an entire primitive in one forward pass. The layout adapts to the primitive's type, dimensionality, and length, supporting compact boxes and long, variable-length trajectories. Crucially, spatial accuracy need not require reproducing an autoregressive model's exact token sequence. VFlash therefore trains on annotated primitives and directly accepts structurally valid predictions without target-token agreement. Across the evaluated 2D and 3D robot trajectory tasks, VFlash consistently reduces prediction errors relative to autoregressive decoding. Preliminary single-rollout measurements indicate approximately 25x faster generation for 3D point motion forecasting. A world action model conditioned on VFlash plans achieves 70.2% average success across four MolmoSpaces task suites, compared with 62.6% for the baseline.

summary.takeaway: 提出 VFlash，利用视觉基元已知结构进行 Flash 基元解码，联合预测坐标而非逐 token 自回归生成，从而在机器人轨迹任务中降低预测误差并加速视觉规划。
summary.methods: 使用轻量 drafter 一次前向生成完整视觉基元，布局适应基元类型、维度和长度；在标注基元上训练并直接接受结构有效预测，无需与自回归模型 token 序列完全一致；在 2D 和 3D 机器人轨迹任务及 MolmoSpaces 任务套件上评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及检索增强与对齐、多模态学习和跨模态理解与生成，与视觉规划和世界动作模型相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要称单次 rollout 测量显示 3D 点运动预测约快 25 倍，但该测量为初步结果；世界动作模型在四个 MolmoSpaces 任务套件上平均成功率为 70.2%，基线为 62.6%，未说明任务间方差和失败模式。

papers.title: MessyNav: Zero-Shot Navigation via Manipulation in Messy Environments
papers.abstract: Real-world environments are messy, with paths often blocked by everyday objects like chairs and toys, requiring robots to perform interactive navigation by manipulating obstacles to clear a path. Existing methods rely on extensive simulation-based learning or per-scene instructions specifying which objects to avoid or manipulate. They struggle to generalize across novel objects, diverse environments, and varied contexts such as a cart of fragile glassware that should be avoided while an empty one can be pushed. We formalize this problem as open-world interactive navigation and present MessyNav, a zero-shot framework based on vision-language models (VLMs). At its core, MessyNav performs explicit VLM-based affordance reasoning before task planning to decide whether to swipe, pick up, or avoid an object and produce a high-level plan. Evaluated on a mobile manipulator across real-world indoor and outdoor environments, MessyNav improves success rate by 27 percentage points (pp) over the strongest baseline in real-robot trials and achieves statistically significant gains in a larger-scale offline evaluation, without task-specific training.

summary.takeaway: 提出 MessyNav，一种基于视觉语言模型的零样本框架，通过显式可供性推理决定对障碍物是推开、拾起还是避开，从而在杂乱环境中实现交互式导航。
summary.methods: 将问题形式化为开放世界交互导航；在任务规划前进行基于 VLM 的可供性推理，生成高层计划；在移动操作平台上进行真实室内外环境和更大规模离线评估，无需任务特定训练。
summary.relevance: 涉及检索增强与对齐、多模态学习和跨模态理解与生成，与视觉语言模型在机器人导航中的应用相关。
summary.caveat: 真实机器人试验中成功率比最强基线提高 27 个百分点，但试验规模和统计细节未在摘要中说明；离线评估虽称统计显著，但未给出效应量；零样本方法对 VLM 可供性推理错误的鲁棒性未讨论。

papers.title: Spectral Adaptive Repositioning for Flow-Based Single-Cell Perturbation Modeling
papers.abstract: Predicting transcriptome-wide cellular responses to genetic and biomolecular perturbations is central to functional genomics and therapeutic target discovery. Existing methods assign gene positional encodings derived from arbitrary orderings or static co-expression masks built from unperturbed cells, and cannot capture the functional rewiring induced by perturbations. We present SPEAR, a generative framework built on two complementary positional mechanisms. Spectral positional encoding grounds each gene's position in the geometry of the co-expression network via continuous coordinates derived from the graph Laplacian. Adaptive repositioning then derives each gene's position from its perturbation-conditioned hidden state at every layer, allowing the attention genes exert on one another to reorganize without explicit supervision. Evaluated on genetic, pharmacological, and cytokine perturbation benchmarks, SPEAR demonstrates excellent recovery of differential gene-expression, distributional structure, and perturbation-specific identifiability. SPEAR also captures latent positional relationships that closely map to known transcription factor-target interactions. https://github.com/shouryaverma/SPEAR}{https://github.com/shouryaverma/SPEAR

summary.takeaway: 提出 SPEAR，一种基于谱位置编码和自适应重定位的生成框架，用于预测全转录组细胞对遗传和生物分子扰动的响应，并能捕获与已知转录因子-靶标相互作用对应的潜在位置关系。
summary.methods: 谱位置编码通过图拉普拉斯特征坐标将每个基因定位在共表达网络几何中；自适应重定位在每一层根据扰动条件隐藏状态推导基因位置，使基因间注意力无需显式监督即可重组；在遗传、药理学和细胞因子扰动基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接针对单细胞扰动建模主题，预测转录组范围扰动响应并关联转录因子-靶标相互作用。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体定量指标；评估集中于差异基因表达恢复、分布结构和扰动特异性可识别性，未说明在未见扰动类型或跨数据集泛化上的表现；方法依赖共表达网络构建质量。
