papers.title: Gene Regulatory Networks that Support Multi-fate Cellular Decisions.
papers.abstract: Cell fate decisions are driven by gene regulatory networks (GRNs). While the mutually inhibitory toggle switch effectively models binary fate decisions, fully connected inhibitory networks with more than two nodes fail to capture multi-fate decisions due to the low prevalence of "single high states", where only a single master regulator is highly expressed. The goal of this study is to find network structures that support all single high states. We find that the only network that attains the highest possible prevalence of all single high states within the set of monotone Boolean (MB) models is completely disconnected. Since biological networks typically require connectivity, we investigate network structures that support equipotency, where all single high states have equal prevalence within MB models. Finally, we characterize the networks that support multistability between all single high states, finding that it is possible only in networks in which each node either has self-activations or is inhibited by every other network node. Our findings provide a theoretical framework for understanding the network design principles that can support simultaneous differentiation into multiple distinct cell types.

summary.takeaway: 该研究用单调布尔模型寻找能支持多命运细胞决策中所有“单高态”的基因调控网络结构，指出完全断开网络单高态流行度最高，而等势性和多稳态需要特定连接条件。
summary.methods: 在单调布尔（MB）模型框架下分析基因调控网络结构，考察所有单高态的流行度、等势性以及所有单高态之间的多稳态条件。
summary.relevance: 直接关联GRN/Regulon主题，为理解基因调控网络设计原则及多细胞命运分化提供理论框架。
summary.caveat: 摘要为理论建模研究，未报告实验验证或具体生物数据；结论基于单调布尔模型假设。

papers.title: Finely tuned DDA-PASEF-based immunopeptidomics workflow enhances HLA class I coverage
papers.abstract: Mass spectrometry-based immunopeptidomics is essential for the direct identification of HLA-presented peptides, but its application to low-input and clinical samples remains challenging. In this study, we present an optimized DDA-PASEF-based workflow to improve HLA class I peptide coverage. First, we optimized a magnetic bead-based sample preparation protocol to support analysis from reduced starting material and increase compatibility with automation. We then evaluated LC gradient length and column dimensions to define complementary configurations for high-throughput and high-coverage analysis. For MS acquisition, we fine-tuned key parameters, including ion accumulation time, number of PASEF scans, ion mobility range, and polygon filtering, to improve sensitivity while maintaining a suitable cycle time and limiting pre-CID truncations. The customized polygon filter improved the detection of singly charged HLA class I peptides, thereby broadening the identified immunopeptide repertoire. Finally, TIMS2Rescore was integrated to improve confidence in peptide identification. Overall, this optimized workflow improves HLA class I immunopeptide coverage across different sample types, even from low injected sample amounts, supporting its future applicability to clinically relevant samples.

summary.takeaway: 提出优化的DDA-PASEF免疫肽组学工作流，通过样本制备、LC配置、MS参数和TIMS2Rescore整合提升HLA I类免疫肽覆盖度，包括低上样量场景。
summary.methods: 优化磁珠样本制备以支持低起始材料和自动化；评估LC梯度长度与色谱柱尺寸；微调离子积累时间、PASEF扫描数、离子淌度范围和polygon过滤；定制polygon过滤改善单电荷HLA I类肽检测；整合TIMS2Rescore提高鉴定置信度。
summary.relevance: 匹配“检索增强与对齐”主题较间接，主要涉及质谱免疫肽组学流程优化与肽鉴定置信度提升。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体覆盖度提升数值或与其他流程的定量比较；临床适用性仅为未来方向，尚未验证。

papers.title: Bridging Structure and Semantics: Knowledge Graph Verification via Triple-to-Text Alignment
papers.abstract: Semantic accuracy is an important dimension of knowledge graph quality. Graph-based scoring methods exploit relational structure, while textual representations allow classifiers to draw on knowledge encoded by pre-trained language models (PLMs). We present GenVer, a generative verifier that scores triples using both their serialized form and generated natural language representations (NLRs). A triple-text alignment procedure selects training pairs for a sequence-to-sequence generator; a BERT-based classifier then combines features from each triple and its generated NLR. On four FactFB variants, constructed from FB15k using perturbed negative triples, GenVer obtains the highest classification accuracy among the evaluated baselines, ranging from 88.56% to 91.52%. The experiments suggest that generated representations can help triple classification, while the case analysis also exposes semantic drift and high-confidence errors.

summary.takeaway: 提出生成式验证器GenVer，利用三元组序列化形式与生成的自然语言表示联合评分，在FactFB变体上取得最高分类准确率。
summary.methods: 通过三元组-文本对齐选择训练对，训练序列到序列生成器生成自然语言表示，再用BERT分类器融合三元组及其生成表示的特征；在四个由FB15k构造的FactFB变体上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接关联知识图谱主题，关注知识图谱三元组语义准确性验证。
summary.caveat: 案例分 析暴露语义漂移和高置信度错误；评估限于FactFB变体，未说明对其他知识图谱的泛化。

papers.title: Selective Retrieval Routing for Multi-Violation Knowledge Graph Repair
papers.abstract: Knowledge graphs often contain missing or inconsistent facts that undermine the applications built on them. Schema validation detects such violations but does not identify which of several valid repairs recovers the intended graph. External corpora can supply the evidence needed to identify the intended repair, but retrieving from them is costly and not always successful. We propose a framework for selective retrieval in iterative graph repair. An LLM repair agent explores and edits the graph, while a router controls its access to a researcher agent that retrieves external evidence. We extend a violation-injection framework to generate cases with multiple compatible violations and known reference repairs. The agent's repair outcomes on these cases provide supervision for training the deployment-specific router. On two building-automation datasets, researcher access improves repairs for some violations and degrades them for others, with effects differing across deployments. The router uses fewer repair-time tokens than always enabling access in all six evaluation suites. It achieves higher repair $F_1$ than always disabling access in five of six suites.

summary.takeaway: 提出面向多违规知识图谱修复的选择性检索路由框架，由路由器控制LLM修复代理是否访问外部证据检索代理，以平衡修复效果与检索成本。
summary.methods: 扩展违规注入框架生成含多个兼容违规和已知参考修复的案例；LLM修复代理迭代探索和编辑图，路由器基于修复结果监督训练；在两个楼宇自动化数据集和六个评估套件上测试。
summary.relevance: 直接关联知识图谱主题，涉及知识图谱不一致事实修复与外部证据检索。
summary.caveat: 外部检索对不同违规的修复效果有正有负且随部署而异；路由策略为部署特定训练，泛化性未充分说明。

papers.title: Do sEMG Foundation Models Improve Cross-Subject Generalisation?
papers.abstract: sEMG Foundation Models aim to learn general purpose representations over diverse subjects and recording conditions that boost performance on a variety of downstream tasks. However, existing evaluations make it difficult to discern whether pretraining alone is sufficient to combat the cross-subject overfitting which makes machine learning on sEMG so challenging. We conduct a systematic evaluation of three sEMG foundation models across three gesture classification datasets under both intra-session and inter-subject splits, using three fine-tuning strategies designed to isolate the contribution of pretraining. We find that pretraining boosts performance when train and test samples are drawn from the same recording session, but this benefit largely disappears under inter-subject evaluation. In low subject count datasets, pretraining provides little to no benefit and classical ML baselines match or exceed foundation model performance.

summary.takeaway: 系统评估发现sEMG基础模型的预训练收益在同记录会话内明显，但在跨受试者评估下大幅消失；小受试者数据集中经典ML基线可匹配或超过基础模型。
summary.methods: 评估三个sEMG基础模型、三个手势分类数据集，在会话内和跨受试者划分下使用三种微调策略以隔离预训练贡献。
summary.relevance: 直接关联预训练主题，检验基础模型预训练对跨受试者泛化的实际作用。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体模型名、数据集名和效应量；结论限于所评估的三个模型和三个手势分类数据集。

papers.title: When GeoFMs Meet VHR: Benchmarking Foundation Models on Very High Resolution Earth Observation Imagery
papers.abstract: Geospatial foundation models are a widely adopted starting point for remote sensing tasks. Most are pretrained on Sentinel-1/2 and Landsat imagery at a ground sampling distance (GSD) of 10m or coarser. Many applications instead rely on very high resolution (VHR) imagery, where individual buildings, roads, and amenities are resolved. We study which pretraining regimes transfer well to this scale. We introduce VHR-Bench, a benchmark suite of ten datasets at 1.5m GSD or finer spanning five task families, eight application domains, and both satellite and aerial platforms. We evaluate twelve encoders in three pretraining tiers with frozen backbones at two training-data fractions. We find that both pretraining on large natural-image collections and VHR-specific pretraining transfer effectively to VHR tasks, with complementary strengths. SkySense leads when labels are scarce; at the full label fraction the web-pretrained DINOv3 ViT-L edges ahead, with the two close together there. Encoders pretrained only on Sentinel-scale imagery transfer least well under RGB input. Guided by these complementary results, we continue the self-supervised pretraining of DINOv3 ViT-L on 1.02 million held-out VHR tiles and evaluate the resulting encoder without changing the downstream protocol. The continued model gives a clear improvement over the released backbone when labels are scarce and a modest one at the full fraction, at no increase in inference parameters or compute. These findings support a generalize-then-specialize strategy: already strong, broad natural-image pretraining can be further improved by a short VHR continuation stage while preserving its general visual features.

summary.takeaway: 引入VHR-Bench评估地理空间基础模型在甚高分辨率遥感影像上的迁移，发现自然图像预训练和VHR特定预训练均有效且优势互补，并提出先泛化后特化的继续预训练策略。
summary.methods: 构建含十个数据集、1.5m GSD或更细、覆盖五类任务和八个应用领域的基准；以冻结骨干在两种训练数据比例下评估十二个编码器；继续在102万张保留VHR瓦片上对DINOv3 ViT-L做自监督预训练。
summary.relevance: 直接关联预训练主题，比较不同预训练范式向VHR遥感的迁移效果。
summary.caveat: 评估采用冻结骨干，未系统考察其他微调方式；继续预训练仅基于DINOv3 ViT-L一个模型。

papers.title: Generate-then-Rank: Learning Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Goal interpretation is to translate a natural language instruction into a formal symbolic goal that a planner can execute. It is critical for embodied agents because any error here propagates to every downstream planning and action step. Doing it well requires both generating suitable candidates and reliably selecting among them. We present a two-stage generate-then-rank approach to Goal Interpretation in the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI). First, supervised fine-tuning adapts a Large Language Model (LLM) to EAI's output convention. Second, Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors (CORE) learns preferences over complete outputs from the model's own generated alternatives. We conducted experiments on the household scenes of the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark. Multiple open source LLMs including DeepSeek-V3 chat, DeepSeek-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-72B were evaluated. The proposed method outperformed the baseline models including LLMs with simple prompting, chain-of-thought, and knowledge graph based approaches.

summary.takeaway: 提出先生成后排序的两阶段目标解释方法，先监督微调LLM适配EAI输出约定，再用CORE从模型自身生成候选中学习偏好，在EAI家庭场景基准上优于简单提示、思维链和知识图谱基线。
summary.methods: 对LLM进行监督微调；提出Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors（CORE）学习完整输出偏好；在Embodied Agent Interface基准家庭场景上评估DeepSeek-V3 chat、DeepSeek-Reasoner、Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen2.5-72B等开源LLM。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型和知识图谱主题，涉及LLM生成符号目标及候选排序。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体性能数值和统计显著性；评估限于EAI家庭场景基准。

papers.title: Obstetric pharmacometabolomics.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Pregnancy-related physiologic and metabolic changes influence drug exposure and response. Yet therapeutic decisions often lack individualized biologic guidance. Obstetric pharmacometabolomics uses endogenous metabolic signatures to investigate and potentially predict and monitor drug response in pregnancy. AREAS COVERED: PubMed/MEDLINE and Google Scholar were searched from inception through October 12, 2026, using terms related to metabolomics, pharmacometabolomics, medication exposure, treatment response, maternal-placental-fetal metabolism, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and obstetric medications. Human pregnancy studies, longitudinal investigations, drug-perturbation experiments, and mechanistic preclinical studies were prioritized. This review examines pregnancy-specific metabolic adaptations, analytical approaches, and potential applications involving aspirin, antihypertensives, antidiabetic therapies, antiretrovirals, antimicrobials, corticosteroids, and psychiatric medications. It also considers pharmacometabolic approaches to preeclampsia, gestational diabetes mellitus, preterm birth, fetal growth disorders, obesity, and HIV-associated pregnancy. EXPERT OPINION: Obstetric pharmacometabolomics offers a promising framework for individualized therapeutics, but clinical implementation requires longitudinal studies, standardized biospecimen collection, rigorous exposure assessment, validated biomarkers, and diverse populations. Integration with pharmacogenomics, pharmacomicrobiomics, pharmacoproteomics, and model-informed drug development can improve therapeutic precision, provided that clinical utility is demonstrated.
